## Model M — Unique 5-Step Methodology
1. **Mikud (Focus)** — Identifying the business goal and strategic direction
2. **Mitzuv (Positioning)** — Defining competitive advantage and market positioning
3. **Mapat Drachim (Roadmap)** — Building a detailed action plan with timelines and KPIs
4. **Mentoring** — Close guidance and support throughout execution
5. **Minof (Leverage)** — Realization and sustainable business growth
